legend.vccMin: lowest since-boot unit supply Vcc (mV) across the display — the brownout floor
legend.units: per-unit array, one entry per display column
legend.fw: firmware vs bundle: 0 ok / 1 outdated / 2 unknown
legend.fl: status flag bitfield (bit0 moving, bit1 home-failed, bit2 hall-never, bit4 addr-eeprom, bit5 homed)
legend.ae: 1 = I2C address came from EEPROM, not DIP
legend.vmin: since-boot minimum supply Vcc (mV), sampled mid-move
legend.age: ms since the last good scheduled health read (heartbeat freshness)
legend.stale: 1 = unit missed >= the threshold of consecutive heartbeats (lost)
legend.err: cumulative failed unit-bus transactions charged to this address
legend.errAge: ms since this unit's last charged bus error
legend.se: step-excess on the last home (actual minus expected steps)
legend.sag: minimum loaded supply Vcc (mV) during the last move
legend.he: hall edges seen in the last completed revolution
legend.dw: rolling ~60 s duty window (recent move count)
legend.pv: wire protocol version the unit reports
legend.pmm: 1 = protocol version we do not speak; unit is untouched and is a reflash target
legend.gates: active unit feature-gate bits (bit0 idle hall check; no other bit is implemented)
legend.sxl: worst-seen step-excess over the unit's lifetime (sx forgets at reboot)
legend.stw0: hall window measured by the unit's FIRST self-test (baseline)
legend.stw1: hall window measured by its most recent self-test
legend.str0: steps/rev measured by the unit's FIRST self-test (baseline)
legend.str1: steps/rev measured by its most recent self-test
legend.fr: idle hall re-homes this boot that found no drift (the window model, not the belief)
legend.frd: 1 = the unit disarmed its own idle hall check; it is not protecting this unit
legend.ntpAge: seconds since last SNTP sync (-1 = never)
legend.hist: history ring of the spark series
legend.degraded: member marked degraded (30 s without a successful contact, #385)
legend.suspect: member failing contacts but not yet degraded (#385 quiet tier)
legend.renderStuck: member alive but its segment undeliverable for 30 s (#385)
legend.failures: contact failures since the last success
legend.role: member deviceRole (#332 tiers; absent = pre-#332 peer, keeps the old width-0-preferred slot)
legend.updating: a member firmware push is in flight
legend.updateBlocked: rollout gave up after the attempt cap
legend.hmac: leader is signing wire-auth (HMAC) to this member (#313)
legend.imageVerifyFailed: the running image failed self-verify for streaming
legend.followerImage: a stored ESP-01 follower image is present
legend.followerPush: an ESP-01 follower image push is in flight
